items.quote: Do you ever feel like you’re one good client away from a breakthrough … but somehow the deals still slip?
items.statement: Do you ever feel like you’re one good client away from a breakthrough … but somehow the deals still slip?

items.quote: That usually means one of three things is happening: • you’re losing clients in the follow-up stage • you’re not controlling the conversation during presentation • you’re getting “I’ll think about it” at the exact moment you need commitment
items.statement: You’re losing clients in the follow-up stage, you’re not controlling the conversation during presentation, you’re getting 'I’ll think about it.'

items.quote: I made a 5-minute survey to understand what’s blocking agents from closing off-plan deals right now - so the next training modules are built around real problems
items.statement: I made a 5-minute survey to understand what’s blocking agents from closing off-plan deals right now.

items.quote: And if you know someone who’s chasing their first 1M in commission this year - please share this post with them.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing challenges faced by real estate agents selling off-plan properties and a survey to gather insights.
